passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: He was preparing swarms of locusts just after the king’s harvest, as the late spring crop was coming up.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD showed me a vision.
He is the God of Israel.
He prepared swarms of locusts.
This happened just after the king’s harvest.
The late spring crop was starting to grow.
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה הִרְאַ֙נִי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְהִנֵּה֙ יוֹצֵ֣ר גֹּבַ֔י בִּתְחִלַּ֖ת עֲל֣וֹת הַלָּ֑קֶשׁ וְהִ֨נֵּה־ לֶ֔קֶשׁ אַחַ֖ר גִּזֵּ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: And when the locusts had eaten every green plant in the land, I said, “Lord GOD, please forgive! How will Jacob survive, since he is so small?”
passages.sermon:
The prophet Amos saw a vision from the Lord GOD.
God sent locusts to eat every green plant in the land.
The locusts destroyed all the plants.
Amos spoke to the Lord GOD.
He said, "Lord GOD, please forgive."
He asked, "How will Jacob survive?"
He explained, "Jacob is so small."
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ כִּלָּה֙ לֶֽאֱכוֹל֙ אֶת־ עֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָ֔רֶץ וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ סְֽלַֽח־ נָ֔א מִ֥י יָק֖וּם יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י קָטֹ֖ן הֽוּא׃

passages.text: So the LORD relented from this plan. “It will not happen,” He said.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD saw what was about to happen.
The LORD changed His mind about this plan.
The LORD said, “This will not happen.”
passages.original: נִחַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ זֹ֑את לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: The Lord GOD was calling for judgment by fire. It consumed the great deep and devoured the land.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD showed me a vision.
The Lord GOD called for judgment by fire.
The fire consumed the great deep.
The fire devoured the land.
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה הִרְאַ֙נִי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה קֹרֵ֛א לָרִ֥ב בָּאֵ֖שׁ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וַתֹּ֙אכַל֙ אֶת־ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֔ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אֶת־ הַחֵֽלֶק׃

passages.text: Then I said, “Lord GOD, please stop! How will Jacob survive, since he is so small?”
passages.sermon:
The prophet Amos spoke to the Lord GOD.
Amos said, “Lord GOD, please stop.”
Amos asked, “How will Jacob survive?”
Jacob is very small.
Jacob is weak and vulnerable.
Jacob cannot stand on his own.
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ חֲדַל־ נָ֔א מִ֥י יָק֖וּם יַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י קָטֹ֖ן הֽוּא׃

passages.text: So the LORD relented from this plan. “It will not happen either,” said the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon: The LORD is God.\r\nThe LORD changed His mind about this plan.\r\nThe LORD said, “This will not happen.”
passages.original: נִחַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ זֹ֑את גַּם־ הִיא֙ לֹ֣א תִֽהְיֶ֔ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס

passages.text: This is what He showed me: Behold, the Lord was standing by a wall true to plumb, with a plumb line in His hand.
passages.sermon:
God showed me a vision.
The Lord stood by a wall.
The wall was straight and true.
The Lord held a plumb line in His hand.
passages.original: כֹּ֣ה הִרְאַ֔נִי וְהִנֵּ֧ה אֲדֹנָ֛י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־ חוֹמַ֣ת אֲנָ֑ךְ וּבְיָד֖וֹ אֲנָֽךְ׃

passages.text: “Amos, what do you see?” asked the LORD. “A plumb line,” I replied. “Behold,” said the Lord, “I am setting a plumb line among My people Israel; I will no longer spare them: The high places of Isaac will be deserted, and the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise up against the house of Jeroboam with My sword.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Amos.
The LORD asked, “Amos, what do you see?”
Amos answered, “A plumb line.”
The Lord said, “I am setting a plumb line among My people Israel.”
The Lord said, “I will not spare them any longer.”
The Lord said, “The high places of Isaac will become deserted.”
The Lord said, “The sanctuaries of Israel will be destroyed.”
The Lord said, “I will attack the house of Jeroboam with the sword.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י מָֽה־ אַתָּ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ עָמ֔וֹס וָאֹמַ֖ר אֲנָ֑ךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹנָ֗י הִנְנִ֨י שָׂ֤ם אֲנָךְ֙ בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא־ אוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד עֲב֥וֹר לֽוֹ׃ וְנָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ בָּמ֣וֹת יִשְׂחָ֔ק וּמִקְדְּשֵׁ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יֶחֱרָ֑בוּ וְקַמְתִּ֛י עַל־ בֵּ֥ית יָרָבְעָ֖ם בֶּחָֽרֶב׃פ

passages.text: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent word to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel. The land cannot bear all his words, for this is what Amos has said: ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will surely go into exile, away from their homeland.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the priest at Bethel.
Amaziah sent a message to Jeroboam.
Jeroboam was the king of Israel.
Amaziah said to Jeroboam, “Amos has conspired against you.
Amos did this among the people of Israel.
The land cannot endure all the words of Amos.
Amos has said, ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword.’
Amos has also said, ‘Israel will go into exile.
Israel will be taken away from its land.’”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֲמַצְיָה֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל אֶל־ יָרָבְעָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר קָשַׁ֨ר עָלֶ֜יךָ עָמ֗וֹס בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹא־ תוּכַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ לְהָכִ֖יל אֶת־ כָּל־ דְּבָרָֽיו׃ כִּי־ כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר עָמ֔וֹס בַּחֶ֖רֶב יָמ֣וּת יָרָבְעָ֑ם וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל גָּלֹ֥ה יִגְלֶ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: And Amaziah said to Amos, “Go away, you seer! Flee to the land of Judah; earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the priest at Bethel.
Amaziah spoke to Amos.
Amaziah called Amos a seer.
Amaziah told Amos to leave.
Amaziah told Amos to flee to the land of Judah.
Amaziah told Amos to earn his bread in Judah.
Amaziah told Amos to prophesy in Judah.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲמַצְיָה֙ אֶל־ עָמ֔וֹס חֹזֶ֕ה לֵ֥ךְ בְּרַח־ לְךָ֖ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וֶאֱכָל־ שָׁ֣ם לֶ֔חֶם וְשָׁ֖ם תִּנָּבֵֽא׃

passages.text: But never prophesy at Bethel again, because it is the sanctuary of the king and the temple of the kingdom.”
passages.sermon:
Amaziah spoke to Amos.
Amaziah was the priest at Bethel.
Amaziah told Amos not to prophesy at Bethel again.
Bethel is the sanctuary of the king.
Bethel is the temple of the kingdom.
passages.original: וּבֵֽית־ אֵ֔ל לֹֽא־ תוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד לְהִנָּבֵ֑א כִּ֤י מִקְדַּשׁ־ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ ה֔וּא וּבֵ֥ית מַמְלָכָ֖ה הֽוּא׃ס

passages.text: “I was not a prophet,” Amos replied, “nor was I the son of a prophet; rather, I was a herdsman and a tender of sycamore-fig trees.
passages.sermon:
Amos spoke to Amaziah.
Amos said, "I am not a prophet.
I am not the son of a prophet.
I am a herdsman.
I take care of sycamore-fig trees."
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַן עָמוֹס֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ אֲמַצְיָ֔ה לֹא־ נָבִ֣יא אָנֹ֔כִי וְלֹ֥א בֶן־ נָבִ֖יא אָנֹ֑כִי כִּֽי־ בוֹקֵ֥ר אָנֹ֖כִי וּבוֹלֵ֥ס שִׁקְמִֽים׃

passages.text: But the LORD took me from following the flock and said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to My people Israel.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
I was a herdsman.
I followed the flock.
The LORD took me away from the flock.
The LORD gave me a command.
He said, "Go."
He said, "Prophesy to my people Israel."
passages.original: וַיִּקָּחֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֔ה מֵאַחֲרֵ֖י הַצֹּ֑אן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ יְהוָ֔ה לֵ֥ךְ הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־ עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Now, therefore, hear the word of the LORD. You say: ‘Do not prophesy against Israel; do not preach against the house of Isaac.’
passages.sermon:
Amos was a herdsman and a tender of sycamore-fig trees.
God called Amos to be a prophet to Israel.
Amos spoke to Amaziah.
Amos said, "Now, hear the word of the LORD."
You say, 'Do not prophesy against Israel.'
You say, 'Do not preach against the house of Isaac.'
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה שְׁמַ֣ע דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֑ה אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֗ר לֹ֤א תִנָּבֵא֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹ֥א תַטִּ֖יף עַל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂחָֽק׃

passages.text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, and your sons and daughters will fall by the sword. Your land will be divided by a measuring line, and you yourself will die on pagan soil. And Israel will surely go into exile, away from their homeland.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD says these words to you.
Your wife will become a prostitute in the city.
Your sons will die by the sword.
Your daughters will die by the sword.
People will divide your land with a measuring line.
You will die on unclean, foreign soil.
Israel will surely go into exile.
Israel will be taken away from its own land.
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אִשְׁתְּךָ֞ בָּעִ֤יר תִּזְנֶה֙ וּבָנֶ֤יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֔לוּ וְאַדְמָתְךָ֖ בַּחֶ֣בֶל תְּחֻלָּ֑ק וְאַתָּ֗ה עַל־ אֲדָמָ֤ה טְמֵאָה֙ תָּמ֔וּת וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל גָּלֹ֥ה יִגְלֶ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃ס
